name: Studios Rental
description: Discover our dance studios, used for classes and available for rent. In addition to organizing parties in iconic Parisian venues, Rock 4 You organizes its 4-Step Rock classes in its own dance studios, located in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. Our studios are available for rent, whether for classes, rehearsals, workshops, events, or artistic projects. ## Our dance studios. ### Danse Cadix — 2 Rue de Cadix, 75015 Paris. Danse Cadix is one of Rock 4 You's main studios. It hosts both regular classes and one-off events, and is available for rental, whether for artistic, educational or event projects. Subject to availability, the Danse Cadix studio can be rented:. ##### Samedi soir. Our dance studios are available for rent for classes, rehearsals, workshops, events or artistic projects, whether one-off or regular. Located a stone's throw from the Alésia metro station, the Patronage Saint-Pierre hall regularly hosts Rock 4 You for the Rock That Alésia evenings, in a warm and decidedly dance-oriented setting.
